title: Augmented Hypothesis Testing with Persona-Based LLM Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2609.24629v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A/B testing requires large sample sizes, long timelines, and significant costs. When auxiliary predictions of experimental outcomes are available from machine learning models, uncertain prediction quality precludes replacing human experiments entirely, yet these predictions may still contain useful signal. We propose a principled framework for learning-augmented hypothesis testing that leverages predictions of unknown quality to reduce sample sizes while maintaining statistical validity. translated_title: 基于角色化大语言模型模拟的增强假设检验
translated_abstract: A/B测试需要大样本量、长周期和高昂的成本。当机器学习模型能够提供实验结果的辅助预测时，由于预测质量的不确定性，这些预测无法完全替代真人实验，但仍可能包含有用的信号。我们提出了一个有原则的学习增强假设检验框架，利用质量未知的预测来减少样本量，同时保持统计有效性。预测的粒度天然存在差异，从粗粒度的聚合信号到细粒度的个体级估计，我们的框架覆盖了这一谱系的两端：（1）对于总体层面的方向性预测，即仅有关于处理效应符号的二值信号时，我们采用非对称检验，并在学习增强算法范式内证明了一致性与鲁棒性界；（2）对于个体级预测，我们……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一个学习增强假设检验框架，能够利用质量未知的机器学习预测——从总体级方向信号到个体级估计——在保持统计有效性的前提下减少A/B测试所需的样本量。
en_tdlr: A principled learning-augmented hypothesis testing framework that leverages predictions of unknown quality, from population-level directional signals to individual-level estimates, to reduce A/B testing sample sizes while maintaining statistical validity.
